findings.summary: Share transfer from Tate brothers to Posillipo Enterprises FZCO (via Georgiana Naghel) confirmed on/around 22 August 2022 — day of Andrew Tate's Meta ban
findings.detail: Westminster Magistrates' Court ruling (CCDC v TTJ, 18 Dec 2024, para 21(i)) states verbatim: 'EAT was a 5% shareholder, TT was a 95% shareholder, until 22 August 2022 when an associate was appointed as sole shareholder and the company changed its name to Posillipo Enterprises-FZCO with a registered office in the UAE.' Note: court language condenses two events — Romanian company rename and share transfer to UAE entity — into one sentence. Romanian registries list entity as Ground Breaking Development SRL. Transfer via intermediate nominee Georgiana Naghel.
findings.target_name: Posillipo Enterprises FZCO (Dubai Silicon Oasis, UAE)

findings.summary: Posillipo FZCO transfer on August 22, 2022 (Meta ban day) is deliberate asset protection implementing Tate's stated UAE tax/legal shield strategy; UAE free zone provides no-UBO-registry opacity over EUR 908,000 Romanian property
findings.detail: The transfer chain Tates → Naghel (~12 days) → Posillipo FZCO (Tyson) mirrors the April 2022 pattern of transferring Talisman Enterprises to Naghel after the US Embassy trafficking report. Both use Naghel as a short-term intermediary. The August 2022 transfers occurred on the same day as Andrew Tate's Meta deplatforming, suggesting pre-planned response to anticipated legal pressure. Andrew Tate explicitly articulated the strategy in public recordings: 'let's say you had an online company which is based out of Dubai and you're making money online and the money is banked in Dubai. You don't owe the UK a fucking thing a penny' (cited in CCDC v TTJ, A/531). Posillipo FZCO implements exactly this — interposing a UAE entity with no public UBO registry over EUR 908,000 in Romanian real estate, four months before arrest.
findings.target_name: Posillipo Enterprises FZCO (Dubai Silicon Oasis, UAE)

findings.summary: Romanian transfer document confirms: 20 shares (100%) transferred to Posillipo Enterprises FZCO; Abigail Tyson named as legal representative with full powers
findings.detail: Multiple media sources citing Romanian transfer documents state verbatim: 'Cessation of 20 shares representing 100% of the company to Posllipo Enterprises-FZCO located in Dubai through legal representative Tyson Abigail.' Abigail Tyson was 'appointed as the official representative of the company with full legal powers.' The transfer from Georgiana Naghel to Posillipo FZCO occurred approximately 12 days after Naghel's acquisition, placing it around 3–5 September 2022.
findings.target_name: Posillipo Enterprises FZCO (Dubai Silicon Oasis, UAE)

findings.summary: Romanian money laundering investigation (Case File 1305/D/P/2022) explicitly covers share transfers to intermediaries including Posillipo FZCO as concealment of criminal proceeds
findings.detail: Romanian prosecutor Case File 1305/D/P/2022 (15 June 2023) investigates money laundering related to the Tate brothers, Georgiana Naghel, and associates. Court ruling (CCDC v TTJ, para 31+) summarizes: 'from 2021, on the territory of Romania... obtained money from criminal activities, which they transferred through bank accounts, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and invested in companies, securities and real estate in Romania and abroad, subsequently transferred the shares, through which they acquired the assets, in the names of intermediaries, with a view to concealing and disguising the illicit origin of those assets, and in order to assist the defendants Andrew Tate and Tate Tristan to evade prosecution, trial and execution of sentence.' The transfer to Posillipo FZCO is within scope of this investigation.
findings.target_name: Posillipo Enterprises FZCO (Dubai Silicon Oasis, UAE)

findings.summary: Abigail Tyson (British national, Grimsby, Lincolnshire; Tristan Tate's partner) identified as administrator, listed beneficial owner, and legal representative of Posillipo Enterprises FZCO
findings.detail: Listafirme.eu Romanian registry data for Ground Breaking Development SRL (CUI 43997740) shows: Administrator = 'Ty' (GB — United Kingdom national); Shareholder = 'PO' (AE — United Arab Emirates entity); Beneficial owner = 'Ty'. Multiple media sources identify 'Ty' as Abigail Tyson and 'PO' as Posillipo Enterprises FZCO. Abigail Tyson is a British national from Grimsby, Lincolnshire; long-term partner of Tristan Tate; described as dividing her time between Romania and Dubai. Romanian investigators sought to question her about Tate business activities but she was not accused of any crime.
findings.target_name: Posillipo Enterprises FZCO (Dubai Silicon Oasis, UAE)

findings.summary: Ground Breaking Development SRL (via Posillipo FZCO) holds EUR 908,000 in Romanian real estate; Romanian forensic report calls it a 'front' for Tate brothers
findings.detail: Westminster Magistrates' Court ruling (CCDC v TTJ) para 21(ii) and (iii): 'The company owns extensive land and properties in Romania, which (exhibit AIH/2) were purchased in November and December 2021, March 2022 (total purchase price Euros 908,000).' The Profira Report (Romanian forensic accounting) is cited: the company is described as 'merely a front through which the Respondent brothers conduct their business of an entirely different nature, other than Web portal activities.' TT was 'uncooperative and reluctant to provide information.' Circa EUR 1,421,000 deposited by EAT and TT into company account; luxury cars, maximum security safe, AV and surveillance systems also purchased via company.
findings.target_name: Posillipo Enterprises FZCO (Dubai Silicon Oasis, UAE)

findings.summary: Posillipo Enterprises FZCO most likely registered with IFZA (International Free Zone Authority) at Dubai Silicon Oasis — same probable registrar as Defied Trust Digital Trading FZCO LLC
findings.detail: IFZA (International Free Zone Authority), physically located at Dubai Silicon Oasis, is the most likely registrar for Posillipo Enterprises FZCO based on: (1) geographic match (FZCO at Dubai Silicon Oasis), (2) IFZA is widely used by non-UAE residents for low-cost company formation, (3) Defied Trust Digital Trading FZCO LLC (Andrew Tate's IP holding entity) appears to be registered with the same free zone authority, and (4) IFZA FZCO is the standard suffix for IFZA entities. DSOA (Dubai Silicon Oasis Authority) is the other possibility. Both registries are non-public.
findings.target_name: Posillipo Enterprises FZCO (Dubai Silicon Oasis, UAE)

findings.summary: Defied Trust Digital Trading FZCO LLC (same Dubai Silicon Oasis free zone) holds US trademark portfolio for all major Tate brand marks — confirms cluster of Tate-linked FZCOs at same free zone as Posillipo
findings.detail: USPTO trademark database shows Defied Trust Digital Trading - Fzco Llc filed applications for: ANDREW TATE UNIVERSITY (TM 98119610), THE REAL WORLD (TM 98119587), COBRATATE (TM 98119801), TOP G (TM 98119937), TOPG (TM 98119985), TATE SPEECH EMERGENCY MEETING (TM 98119681), TOP G SUPPLEMENTS (TM 99017098). This entity is also an FZCO — same entity type as Posillipo Enterprises FZCO, and described as being associated with Dubai/Dubai Silicon Oasis free zone (IFZA). This constitutes a cluster of Tate-linked UAE FZCOs at the same free zone, with Posillipo holding the Romanian property/operating subsidiary and Defied Trust holding the IP portfolio.
